name: Care ~Iyasubeki Fuchi no Kyouki~
source:
Main character is a caretaker of diseased girls in a Western-style mansion. He assaults the girls and feels guilt for that. But as he tries to heal their wounds, he feels hatred and revengeful mood from them. Will he continue the treatment approach or burst out in anger?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一座西式宅邸里照料数名患病的少女。他侵犯了她们，内心也因此备受罪恶感折磨。可当他试图治愈她们的创伤时，感受到的却是少女们的仇恨与复仇之心。他究竟会继续治疗，还是终于在愤怒中爆发？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
